environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate (task definition: app-service-prod) behind an Application Load Balancer with no additional rule sets. The PostgreSQL RDS instance (db.t3.medium) uses database user 'webapp_user' which has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the 'appdb' database schema. Session cookies use default SameSite=None due to cross-origin requirements with the frontend SPA on a different subdomain. No CSRF middleware or token validation is implemented.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp_user
config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF association
